title: Nasruddin and the Drum
summary: A braggart struck a giant war drum in the market, shouting: "Listen to the terrifying thunder of my drum!"...
full_text:
A braggart struck a giant war drum in the market, shouting: "Listen to the terrifying thunder of my drum!"

Nasruddin cut open the drum skin with his pocket knife: "Look inside, citizens! It makes a tremendous roar only because it is completely empty inside, just like the heads of conceited men!"
moral: The loudest noise often comes from what is completely empty inside.
